position.en: Across the lower apse wall of the Parekklesion, divided by the central window.

summary.en: Church fathers stand in matching white vestments marked with dark and red crosses, each holding a book and blessing.

position.en: In the apse semi-dome at the east end of the Parekklesion.

summary.en: Radiant Christ breaks the gates of death, binds Satan, and pulls Adam and Eve from their tombs as kings, prophets, and the righteous witness the act.

title.en: Raising of the Widow of Nains Son

position.en: Beside the Anastasis on the lower Parekklesion apse program.

summary.en: Jesus approaches a young man sitting upright on a carried bier while his widowed mother and a startled crowd respond.

position.en: Beside the Anastasis on the lower Parekklesion apse program.

summary.en: Jesus takes the girl's wrist as she rises on an ornate bed; Jairus, women, and apostles surround the intimate interior.

position.en: Across the upper walls and vault adjoining the Anastasis in the Parekklesion.

summary.en: Christ presides over an extensive judgment cycle containing the rolled heavens, Deesis, prepared throne, weighing of souls, resurrection, paradise, and punishment.

title.en: Earth and Sea Give Up the Dead

position.en: On the southwest pendentive of the Parekklesion judgment vault.

summary.en: Michael sounds a trumpet toward sea and land as the dead rise from tombs and even from the mouths of sea creatures.

title.en: An Angel Carries a Judged Soul

position.en: On the northwest pendentive of the Parekklesion judgment vault.

summary.en: A standing angel supports a small praying soul by the head and points toward its destination.

position.en: In paired panels on the judgment vault, opposite the rich man's punishment.

summary.en: Abraham sits enthroned with the small figure of Lazarus in his lap, surrounded by other waiting souls in a garden-like setting.

position.en: On the southeast pendentive of the Parekklesion judgment vault.

summary.en: A naked rich man sits within flames beside spilled coins and money bags, looking toward Lazarus across the vault.

position.en: Where the river of fire descends from Christ's feet into the Parekklesion judgment vault.

summary.en: Small demonic figures lead souls into varied punishments beside the fiery stream and the weighing of deeds.

position.en: At the gate of paradise within the Parekklesion judgment cycle.

summary.en: Peter leads groups of women, martyrs, monks, bishops, and prophets toward a seraph-guarded gate; Mary and the repentant thief appear inside.

position.en: In the central medallion and twelve compartments of the western Parekklesion dome.

summary.en: Mary and the child fill the rainbow-bordered center while twelve standing angels radiate around them; four archangels hold globes.

position.en: On the northeast pendentive beneath the western Parekklesion dome.

summary.en: John of Damascus sits at a writing table with pen, ink, and folded hymn text, framed by architecture.

position.en: On the southeast pendentive beneath the western Parekklesion dome.

summary.en: Kosmas sits with a notebook and dips his pen into an inkwell, wearing layered blue and green garments.

position.en: On the southwest pendentive beneath the western Parekklesion dome.

summary.en: Joseph sits at a low writing station and displays a long scroll associated by the guide with Marian hymnody.

position.en: On the northwest pendentive beneath the western Parekklesion dome.

summary.en: Theophanes writes in a notebook from a low seat, with writing equipment arranged before him.

title.en: Jacobs Ladder and Wrestling with the Angel

position.en: On the left side of the north-wall tympanum in the western Parekklesion bay.

summary.en: Sleeping Jacob sees a ladder carrying angels toward heaven; below, he braces his legs while wrestling an angel.

position.en: On the right side of the north wall in the western Parekklesion bay.

summary.en: Moses turns and covers his face before a burning bush containing an angel and a Marian medallion.

position.en: On the north side of the arch between the eastern and western Parekklesion bays.

summary.en: Above, Moses faces the burning bush; below, he bends to remove his sandals beside his flock and dog.

title.en: Carrying the Ark of the Covenant

position.en: On the right side of the south wall in the eastern Parekklesion bay.

summary.en: Four men carry a brightly striped, chest-like Ark before a mountain and distant architecture.

title.en: Carrying the Menorah and Sacred Vessel

position.en: On the south side of the arch between the eastern and western Parekklesion bays.

summary.en: Two men carry a seven-branched lampstand and a handled sacred vessel toward the Temple.

title.en: Solomon and the Elders of Israel

position.en: On the left side of the south wall in the western Parekklesion bay.

summary.en: Crowned Solomon swings a censer before seven elders who approach against a mountainous landscape.

position.en: On the right side of the south wall in the western Parekklesion bay.

summary.en: Elders place the Ark on a raised altar beneath seraphim; another group looks upward as divine light fills the Temple.

title.en: Isaiahs Prophecy and Michael Defeats the Ass

position.en: On the south side of the western Parekklesion arch.

summary.en: Isaiah holds a prophecy scroll while Michael advances with sword and scabbard before Jerusalem and the defeated Assyrian force.

title.en: Aaron and His Sons at the Altar

position.en: On the north side of the western Parekklesion arch.

summary.en: Aaron and two sons carry offerings toward a stepped altar as a beam descends on the sanctuary.

title.en: Souls of the Righteous in Gods Hand I

position.en: Within the Parekklesion; the source does not provide a differentiating sub-location for F26.

summary.en: The source title and two photographs identify a composition of righteous souls held in a divine hand.

title.en: Souls of the Righteous in Gods Hand II

position.en: Within the Parekklesion; the source does not provide a differentiating sub-location for F27.

summary.en: A separate source photograph is numbered F27 under the same title as F26, indicating a second or differently framed righteous-souls image.

position.en: Within the Parekklesion; the source does not provide a differentiating sub-location for F28.

summary.en: The source title and photograph identify Melchizedek, king and priest of Salem, as an individual sacred figure.

position.en: Within the Parekklesion; the source does not provide a differentiating sub-location for F29.

summary.en: The source title and photograph identify an individual image of Jesus Christ separate from the large Anastasis and Last Judgment figures.

position.en: On an arch within the Parekklesion; the source does not specify which arch or exact face.

summary.en: The source title and photograph identify a portrait of Christ placed on an arch.

title.en: Archangel Michael between Anastasis and Judg

position.en: In the central medallion of the broad bema arch separating the apse Anastasis from the Last Judgment vault.

summary.en: Michael fills a medallion in red, holding a staff and a globe marked with Greek letters while golden wings close behind him.

position.en: On the south pier of the bema arch in the Parekklesion.

summary.en: A life-size Mary stands on a rectangular platform and presses her cheek tenderly to the child Jesus, who holds a scroll.

position.en: Above the main doorway just inside the naos.

summary.en: Mary lies on a bier while Christ holds her swaddled soul within a radiant mandorla; apostles, clergy, women, and angels gather around.

position.en: In the diagonally right corner after entering the naos.

summary.en: Mary stands on a platform holding the child Jesus and points toward him; blue and gold garments and identifying inscriptions frame the pair.

position.en: In the diagonally left corner after entering the naos.

summary.en: Christ stands in a blue mantle with an open Gospel book; loss around the head leaves only traces of the halo.

position.en: In the lunette above the doorway from the outer to the inner narthex.

summary.en: Christ faces slightly toward the opposite Marian panel, blessing with one hand and holding a book with the other; asymmetrical features respond to a moving viewer.

position.en: On the inner upper arch of the old main entrance in the outer narthex.

summary.en: Mary raises her arms in prayer while the Christ child appears in a medallion at her center; two angels incline toward her.

position.en: Immediately left of the passage from the outer to the inner narthex.

summary.en: A heavily damaged Mary holds the child and gestures toward him; only part of the Theon monogram survives.

position.en: The second panel to the left of the passage from the outer to the inner narthex.

summary.en: Mary bends cheek-to-cheek toward the child Jesus; much of both figures and their clothing has been lost.

position.en: Immediately right of the passage from the outer to the inner narthex.

summary.en: Only part of John's shoulder, chest, long hair, halo, and rough garment survives from an almost entirely lost figure.

position.en: On the lower panel behind the leftmost arch of the outer narthex.

summary.en: A surviving lower-panel portrait is identified by the guide as Joachim.

title.en: Virgin Mary above the Tomb Niche

position.en: Above the leftmost tomb niche in the inner narthex.

summary.en: The guide identifies a Marian mosaic positioned above the inner-narthex tomb niche.

position.en: Above the doorway from the inner narthex into the naos.

summary.en: Theodore Metochites kneels in elaborate court dress and offers a model of Chora to the enthroned Christ.

position.en: On the front wall beneath the right-hand dome of the inner narthex.

position.en: In the right-hand dome of the inner narthex.

position.en: In the left-hand dome of the inner narthex.

position.en: On the rear-left pendentive of the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: A priest rejects Joachim's offering while an angelic sign and adjacent figures frame his public disappointment.

position.en: On the front-right pendentive of the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: Joachim sits apart among shepherds and animals after leaving home in grief.

position.en: On the lower-left wall beneath the left inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: Anna confronts a maid within a domestic setting; damage interrupts the figures and architecture.

position.en: On the front arch wall of the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

position.en: On the front face of the arch immediately right of the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: Anna and Joachim embrace at a city gate after receiving news that their prayers will be answered.

position.en: On the front wall of the vault between the first and second bays at the far left of the inner narthex.

summary.en: Anna reclines after childbirth while attendants wash the infant Mary and others prepare the household.

position.en: On the front section of the vault beside the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: Anna and Joachim affectionately hold the young Mary within a domestic architectural setting.

position.en: On the rear section of the vault beside the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: Priests bless the young Mary as her parents present her at a table in their home.

position.en: On the front face of the second arch from the left in the inner narthex.

summary.en: The infant Mary takes seven steps toward Anna while attendants watch the carefully staged movement.

title.en: Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple

position.en: On the rear section of the vault beside the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: The young Mary climbs toward the high priest as her parents and a procession of girls approach the Temple.

title.en: Girls Accompany Mary to the Temple

position.en: On the front section of the vault at the naos entrance in the inner narthex.

summary.en: A group of girls carrying lights accompanies Mary toward her Temple presentation.

position.en: On the front of the third arch from the left, immediately right of the naos doorway in the inner narthex.

summary.en: Mary sits within the Temple while an angel brings food; the priest and architectural enclosure identify the sacred setting.

position.en: On the rear of the third arch from the left, immediately right of the naos doorway in the inner narthex.

summary.en: A fragmentary scene shows Mary within the sequence of her Temple upbringing and education.

position.en: On the rear of the second arch from the left, immediately left of the naos doorway in the inner narthex.

summary.en: Zechariah receives rods associated with Mary's prospective guardians; Joseph's rod is selected by a sign.

position.en: On the rear wall of the vault beside the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: Zechariah entrusts Mary to the older Joseph after the sign of the rods.

position.en: On the rear face of the arch beside the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: Joseph leads Mary from the Temple toward his household as the narrative moves from sacred to domestic space.

position.en: On the rear wall of the vault left of the right-hand inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: Mary receives purple wool allotted for making the Temple veil.

position.en: On the rear wall beneath the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: Joseph departs for work while Mary remains with the household and her assigned wool.

position.en: On the rear-right pendentive of the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: Gabriel approaches Mary with the announcement of Jesus's conception; her spinning materials connect the moment to the preceding Temple-veil episode.

title.en: Josephs Dream and the Journey to Bethlehem

position.en: Above the exit doorway at the far left of the outer narthex.

summary.en: An angel addresses the sleeping Joseph, followed by the journey of Joseph and the pregnant Mary toward Bethlehem.

position.en: On the front wall of the far-left outer-narthex vault at the exit.

summary.en: Mary and Joseph appear before an official and scribes during the enrollment connected with their journey.

position.en: On the front wall of the second vault from the left in the outer narthex.

summary.en: Mary reclines beside the swaddled child in a cave-like setting as Joseph, animals, angels, shepherds, and attendants occupy linked episodes.

position.en: On the front wall of the second vault from the right in the outer narthex.

summary.en: The Magi approach the enthroned Herod, whose court turns their search for the newborn king into a political confrontation.

position.en: On the front wall of the rightmost outer-narthex vault.

summary.en: Herod consults priests and scribes about the prophesied birthplace while the damaged composition preserves only part of the inquiry.

title.en: The Magi Return by Another Way

position.en: High in the vault of the current entrance, toward the passage to the Parekklesion.

summary.en: A damaged remnant represents the Magi leaving by a different route after being warned not to return to Herod.

position.en: Immediately above the inner side of the current entrance doorway in the outer narthex.

summary.en: The Holy Family travels away from Herod's threat, with Mary and the child mounted while Joseph guides the journey.

position.en: On the right wall of the rightmost vault in the outer narthex.

summary.en: Herod issues his command to armed soldiers; surviving details include the ruler, attendants, and the movement of troops.

position.en: On the rear wall of the rightmost outer-narthex vault.

summary.en: Soldiers attack children as mothers resist and grieve; extensive loss fragments the violent action.

position.en: On the rear wall of the second vault from the right in the outer narthex.

summary.en: Mothers lament the murdered children through bent bodies, raised hands, and tightly held figures.

position.en: On the rear of the third vault from the right in the outer narthex.

summary.en: Elizabeth carries the young John away from danger as the landscape opens to shelter them.

position.en: On the rear of the second vault from the left in the outer narthex.

summary.en: An angel informs Joseph of Herod's death, followed by the Holy Family's return journey.

position.en: On the rear wall of the far-left outer-narthex vault.

summary.en: Mary and Joseph bring the young Jesus toward Jerusalem in a family procession.

position.en: In the far-left vault of the outer narthex.

summary.en: The young Jesus sits among teachers in the Temple while Mary and Joseph find him after their anxious search.

position.en: In the second vault from the left in the outer narthex.

summary.en: John identifies Jesus and the baptism is represented through the meeting of the two figures and the river setting.

position.en: On the right side of the second vault from the left in the outer narthex.

position.en: On the right side of the second vault from the left in the outer narthex.

summary.en: Satan confronts Jesus through successive temptations, including demands for worship and a vision from a high place.

position.en: On the front-left pendentive of the main-entrance vault in the outer narthex.

position.en: Across the front-right and rear-right pendentives of the main-entrance vault in the outer narthex.

summary.en: Jesus blesses bread as disciples distribute food to a gathered crowd across multiple pendentives.

title.en: Ox Prepared for a Feast Disputed Scene

position.en: On the rear-left pendentive of the main-entrance vault in the outer narthex.

summary.en: A fragmentary ox and attendants appear in a scene associated with preparation for a feast.

position.en: At the front of the fourth vault from the left in the outer narthex.

summary.en: A sick man approaches Jesus for healing while disciples stand behind him; much of the panel is damaged.

title.en: Healing of the Paralytic at Capernaum

position.en: At the rear-right of the rightmost outer-narthex vault.

summary.en: A man brought on a bed encounters Jesus in the Capernaum healing narrative.

title.en: Healing at the Pool of Bethesda

position.en: At the front-left of the rightmost outer-narthex vault.

summary.en: Jesus addresses a long-disabled man beside the pool, with the man's sleeping mat marking his change of condition.

title.en: Healing of the Man with Dropsy

position.en: At the front-right of the rightmost outer-narthex vault.

summary.en: Jesus heals a man described in the source by the historical diagnosis of dropsy or edema.

title.en: Healing of the Man Born Blind

position.en: On the front-right pendentive of the rightmost outer-narthex vault.

summary.en: Jesus reaches toward a blind man in a healing scene associated with sight and recognition.

position.en: On the front-left pendentive of the rightmost outer-narthex vault.

summary.en: A healed man rises and carries the bed that previously carried him.

position.en: On the rear-left pendentive of the rightmost outer-narthex vault.

summary.en: Jesus speaks with a Samaritan woman beside a well, where the vessel and water anchor the conversation.

position.en: In the vault containing the current outer-narthex entrance.

summary.en: Zacchaeus looks toward Jesus from a tree while the surrounding crowd marks his separation and eventual welcome.

title.en: Healing of a Blind and Mute Man

position.en: On the rear-right pendentive of the right-hand inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: Jesus performs a healing identified by the guide as involving blindness and inability to speak.

position.en: On the rear-left pendentive of the right-hand inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: Two blind men approach Jesus together, distinguishing the composition from nearby single-person healings.

title.en: Healing of Peters Mother in Law

position.en: On the front-left pendentive of the right-hand inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: Jesus reaches toward Peter's ill mother-in-law as she rises from her bed.

title.en: Healing of the Woman with a Hemorrhage

position.en: On the front-right pendentive of the right-hand inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: A woman reaches toward Christ's garment within a crowd, seeking healing without interrupting his movement.

title.en: Healing of the Man with a Withered Hand

position.en: On the front of the arch immediately right of the right-hand inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: A young man extends an impaired arm toward Jesus in a healing encounter watched by others.

position.en: On the rear of the arch immediately right of the right-hand inner-narthex dome.

summary.en: A fragmentary supplicant approaches Jesus in a second scene identified with healing a leper.

position.en: On the rear wall beneath the right-hand dome of the inner narthex.

summary.en: Several people approach Christ in a collective healing composition rather than a single named encounter.
